title: Replacing Spatial Filtering With Deep-learning Noise Reduction
official: Replacing Spatial Filtering With Deep-learning Noise Reduction Improves Low-dose Gated SPECT Myocardial Perfusion Imaging
summary: Spatial filtering is routinely required to reduce the statistical noise of gated SPECT myocardial perfusion imaging, but at the expense of image blurring. This study will evaluate a deep-learning-based noise reduction (DLNR) approach, developed to shorten acquisition times, when used as a replacement for conventional spatial filters (CSF).
